fusions.name: Scavenger's Bite
fusions.desc: Bites the target for 8 damage, leaves it 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt. Holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Hull Gnaw
fusions.desc: Gnaws through the thickest hide from up to 4 tiles away, dealing 28 damage, up to 1.5 times that at full range, plus 5% of a boss or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Still Afloat
fusions.desc: For 5 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands.

fusions.name: Last Scramble
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 35%, you regain 4 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 40 seconds.
